The [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]] '''NK-7 ion cannon''' was a powerful ship-based [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] used on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], especially [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]].

==Description==
Manufactured by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]], the NK-7 [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] was a turreted [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted weapon. Each turret had a single cannon which could be raised or lowered by an elevating gun plate that ran on elevation tracking rails.<ref name="EGWT" /> The NK-7 had an optimum range of ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and a maximum range of eighty kilometers. The turrets were coordinated by [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] stations to allow multiple cannons to fire at a single target; a typical volley from NK-7 ion cannons was enough to immobilize a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] for several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

Each emplacement featured a dedicated [[turbine generator]] and [[capacitor bank]]s feeding power to the weapon via an [[Energy Coupler]]. The energy bolt travelled through an ion [[Accu-accelerator/Legends|accu-accelerator]] before being fired out of the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. A [[cooling grid]] was located behind the Energy Coupler, and the [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] crew stations and [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] were situated at the base of the turret.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] mounted sixty Borstel NK-7 ion cannons on their [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator/Legends|Devastator]]'' used NK-7 ion cannons to disable the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'' over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="NEGWT" />
